say.en: A real task, from start to finish.
say.ar: مهمة حقيقية، من البداية إلى النهاية.
say.ja: 本物のタスクを、最初から最後まで。

stops.say: You ask in your own words, with your own files.
It works it out step by step, and shows each step.
What you asked for comes back made: here, a chart.
Press a follow-up to go on.
